fields.description: Issue includes an editorial on a fatal causeway automobile crash involving Fred Osius and criticism of uneven enforcement of motor laws, with mention of Deputy Solicitor Fritz Gordon. Other pieces address Miami Beach policing and the discharge of Detective George Christie, local transportation and streetcar fare complaints, city management and municipal governance, Fourth of July observances and commentary on Prohibition, harbor/wharfage charges affecting shipping, and calls for airport/aviation development. Also includes society/column items, advertisements, and sports coverage including boxing promotions for July 4.
